attempts.input: Tab A held, then the person clicks the notice button 'Reload to see the other copy' after typing more work in the stopped tab B (project name 'B work that matters').
attempts.observed: Before: B status 'Not saving: see the notice', notice 'This project was just changed in another tab or window. The Studio has stopped saving here, so that neither copy replaces the other without your say.' After the click: the page reloaded in 71 ms, B shows 'A changed it', no notice, and the kept-copies list is [] (empty). B's work is gone from storage and from the kept copies. No confirmation said that reloading discards this tab's work; the button text only says 'see the other copy'. Cause in code: flush() returns early when saved==='held' (apps/studio/src/store.ts:692) and the reload action is a bare window.location.reload() (store.ts:247, 463), with no keepBackup of this tab's project.

attempts.input: A stopped tab ('Not saving: see the notice') receives more typing ('A unsaved work, then tab closed'), then the person closes the tab (page.close with runBeforeUnload: true).
attempts.observed: Tab closed in 1 ms with no leave-page warning (the Studio registers no beforeunload handler). Stored copy stays 'A2 (B now saves)'; kept copies: []. The typed work is lost. The status line did say 'Not saving: see the notice' beforehand, so the loss was signalled on screen, but nothing caught it at close.

attempts.input: One tab: type a new project name and close the tab about 14 ms later, before the 300 ms save delay.
attempts.observed: Reopened page shows and stores 'Typed then closed at once'. The pagehide flush saved it. Target held.

attempts.input: Two tabs on the Summary type different project names at the same instant (Promise.all of two fills), repeated in fresh tabs, aiming to beat the cross-tab storage event and reach a silent overwrite or the save-time conflict path.
attempts.observed: In every completed round (6 rounds over two scripts) one tab said 'Saved in this browser, on this computer' and the other said 'Not saving: see the notice' with 'This project was just changed in another tab or window...'. No round had both tabs saying Saved with different names. The save-time conflict path ('after this one opened it') was never reached, so a planned follow-up (Undo back to the last saved text, then 'Keep this tab's copy', which by reading store.ts:211/236 looks like it leaves the status at 'Saving…' and writes nothing) could not be tried through ordinary use. Note: my first scripts stalled after round 3 because my helper waited 30 s for a missing banner; that was my script, not the Studio (a6 shows every tab responding).

attempts.input: Back-forward cache: tab A navigates to about:blank, tab B changes the name, tab A presses Back (Chromium launched without Playwright's --disable-back-forward-cache), hoping A comes back with a stale project and a 'Saved' status. The Studio has no pageshow handler, so a page restored from that cache would not learn of B's change.
attempts.observed: This Chromium never restored the page from the back-forward cache (window marker lost on Back, both via about:blank and via another file page); the page reloaded and showed B's name 'Name from tab B'. A later edit in A saved normally. Not testable here; the theoretical gap (no pageshow persisted handling; storage events are not delivered to a cached page) remains unverified.

attempts.input: Three tabs. B changes the name; A and C stop. A clicks 'Keep this tab’s copy', then C clicks it from its older notice, then B, then A again.
attempts.observed: Each keep stored that tab's copy, its status became 'Saved in this browser, on this computer', and each other tab switched to 'Not saving: see the notice'. Statuses always matched storage. All tabs kept responding. Target held.
